items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment and retain only existing reconciliation work. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 cannot be assigned to sites; site-attributed commission of $0 does not prove zero site performance. AI usage covers 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28: 4,926 calls and $901.90 cost, with 228 errors and 5 transient errors. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align, infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing/experiment costs are incomplete, monthly budget ceilings are blank, and no learning-outcome threshold exists. The 39 awaiting-measurement improvements, 8 failed requests, 2 proven outcomes, and pilot output counts are not financial performance. Continue the existing revenue, attribution, and cost reconciliation using recorded evidence only; do not create duplicate telemetry, spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization changes, or new dispatches.

Handoff: retain the existing affiliate-attribution and revenue/cost reconciliation work only. Preserve the $4.92 provider aggregate as unattributed, reconcile registered tracking IDs and aligned cost periods, and do not infer margin, ROI, payback, budget capacity, or cost-to-learn from clicks, orders, shipped items, sessions, conversions, AI calls, or output counts.
